title: Migration & Transfer — DMS + S3 staging for database moves
topic: AWS DMS full load + CDC, homogeneous vs heterogeneous (SCT), DMS Serverless, DynamoDB export/import via S3, DataSync vs Snowball vs Transfer Family vs MGN, Night 19 backup + DMS delta cutover
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-20-dms-s3-migration.md and night-20-lab-migration-setup scripts. Answer without peeking at night-20-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Legacy on-prem Oracle resort_stats must move to Aurora PostgreSQL with minimal write downtime during cutover. Which AWS pair handles schema conversion and ongoing replication?

options.A: AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT) for DDL + AWS DMS full load and CDC
options.B: AWS DataSync for schema + AWS Backup for CDC
options.C: AWS Snowball Edge for DDL + RDS snapshot export for CDC
options.D: AWS Transfer Family SFTP + DynamoDB import for CDC

questions.question: After DMS full load completes on Postgres→Aurora, production still writes to the source for six hours before cutover. Which DMS task mode keeps the target current?

options.A: Full load only — no further replication after initial copy
options.B: CDC only — assumes target already has all historical rows
options.C: S3 export only — DynamoDB JSON staging replaces CDC
options.D: Full load + CDC — transaction log replication after initial copy

questions.question: A ski-resort NAS holds 600 TB of video. The data center link is 500 Mbps and leadership wants offline transfer. Best primary service?

options.A: AWS DMS replication instance with full load + CDC
options.C: AWS Snowball Edge or Snowball device shipment
options.D: DynamoDB export to point in time

questions.question: Partners must upload daily CSV resort files via SFTP into your landing S3 bucket. Managed service?

options.A: AWS DMS S3 target endpoint with CDC
options.B: AWS DataSync between on-prem NFS and S3
options.D: AWS Transfer Family (managed SFTP) integrated with S3

questions.question: night-20-lab exports saa-study-gsa-wiki-views to s3://saa-study-gsa-migration-298043721974/night-20/dynamodb/wiki-views/. Which prerequisite must be true on the table?

options.A: Point-in-time recovery (PITR) enabled — Night 18 lab pattern
options.B: DynamoDB global tables with two active Regions
options.C: AWS Backup vault lock in the same account

questions.question: Compare AWS DataSync and AWS DMS for the Global Ski Atlas migration portfolio. Which statement is correct?

options.A: DataSync replicates database transaction logs; DMS syncs files only
options.B: DMS migrates databases (full load/CDC); DataSync moves files/objects online
options.C: Both require a Snowball device for initial seed
options.D: DMS replaces S3; DataSync replaces Aurora

questions.question: Same-engine PostgreSQL on RDS must move to Aurora PostgreSQL in the Night 9 VPC. No engine change. Migration type and tool?

options.A: Heterogeneous — requires SCT and Glue ETL only
options.B: Homogeneous — DMS full load + CDC without SCT schema conversion
options.C: Heterogeneous — Snowmobile required for WAL files

questions.question: Ops restored an Aurora cluster from a Night 19 AWS Backup recovery point in a staging VPC. Production source still accepts writes until cutover. What closes the gap?

options.A: Enable DynamoDB PITR on the restored cluster
options.B: CloudTrail data events replay into Aurora
options.C: Route 53 latency routing alone syncs rows
options.D: DMS CDC from live production source to the restored target

questions.question: An exam question mentions variable-duration database migration with no fixed replication instance size. Which DMS option fits?

options.A: DMS Serverless — capacity scales with migration workload

questions.question: You need a portable copy of wiki view counters in S3 for Athena SQL (Night 23 preview), not a new live DynamoDB table. Best export path tonight?

options.B: DynamoDB export to point in time → S3 (night-20-lab pattern)
options.C: AWS Backup recovery point mount as filesystem

questions.question: night-20-lab creates saa-study-gsa-migration-298043721974 tagged saa-study-migration=night-20. What is this bucket's primary role?

options.A: Route 53 health check target for DR failover routing
options.B: Encrypted S3 staging for DynamoDB export files and migration artifacts
options.C: CloudTrail log archive that replaces AWS Backup vault storage
options.D: DMS replication instance root EBS volume snapshot store

questions.question: 200 VMware VMs in the resort data center must rehost to EC2 with minimal OS reinstall. Primary AWS service?
night-20-lab-migration-teardown.ps1 runs after the quiz. What does teardown remove?

options.A: Migration S3 bucket contents and bucket only — Night 18 wiki table remains
options.B: saa-study-gsa-wiki-views and all stream Lambda mappings
options.C: Night 16 Aurora cluster because export referenced resort_stats
options.D: Night 19 backup vault and all recovery points

questions.question: DMS replication instance sits in a private subnet and must reach saa-study-gsa-aurora on 5432. Which network pattern matches the exam?

options.A: Aurora public accessibility = Yes; 0.0.0.0/0 on database SG
options.B: Security group on Aurora allows TCP 5432 from the DMS replication instance security group
options.C: Internet Gateway attached to the DB subnet route table
options.D: NAT Gateway on the Aurora cluster ENI

questions.question: Compare DynamoDB export to S3 (Tonight) with DMS targeting DynamoDB. When is native export the better answer?

options.A: Continuous live replication with sub-second lag to a second table
options.C: Bulk extract to S3 files for analytics or offline staging — no replication instance
options.D: On-prem MySQL binlog CDC into DynamoDB
